quote_zh: It has now been found that 2-halo-3-methyl4-alkylsulfonylbenzoic acids can be converted in very good yields and in very high purities by bromination
The present invention therefore provides a process for preparing 3-bromomethylbenzoic acids of the formula II
by brominating 3-methylbenzoic acids of the formula I
A) N-bromosuccimide in the presence of a radical initiator, or
A) N-bromosuccimide in the presence of a radical initiator, or
B) elemental bromine and irradiation with a photolamp,
